correctness.rationale: At entry the newly appearing color is absent from the M-1 previous common positions; conditional on its identity the common word is uniform onto over N=n-1 symbols. For u<=M-1 the survival probability is sandwiched between Q_N(m-u)/Q_N(m) and that plus (u/n)E[R_u], where R_u is the number of formerly present colors absent from the surviving suffix. Zero-truncated Poisson exact conditioned occupancy law and uniform lattice local CLT give singleton deletion hazard h_N(k)=n^-alpha(1+o(1)) for k=m-O(n^alpha); summing hazards yields exp(-t). Conditional count/suffix estimate E[R_u]=O(u*n^-alpha)=O(1) for u=O(n^alpha), so repair probability O(n^(alpha-1))->0. Exact mean uses stationary on-set mass divided by entry flux, with same singleton-hazard estimate. Independent Fraction enumeration for n,M=(2,3),(3,4),(4,5), u=0,1,2 checks complete entry conditioning and both finite sandwich inequalities. The asymptotic is proved using the uniform local CLT, not finite tests.
residual_risks: Fourier local-CLT derivation is sketched with claimed uniformity, with span-one, growing parameter and shifted mass; validity checked against original zero-truncated Poisson Appendix A rather than independently publishing a full analytic error constant.
Only fixed subcritical alpha and uniform independent coupons; excludes critical, nonuniform and length-biased regimes.
